auth.heroTitle:
Remember the board.
Master the game.
auth.heroBody:
No more looking. Just remembering.
Train your memory with every move, real opponents, and one minute to decide.
auth.registerBody: Create an account and start at 1,200 Elo.
auth.crossPlatform:
One account. Web, iOS, and Android.
Memory Chess only. No standard mode.
auth.tagline: MEMORY CHESS · TRAIN YOUR MIND, ONE MOVE AT A TIME

menu.eyebrow: A TRAINING GROUND FOR YOUR MEMORY
menu.headline: The board disappears.
menu.body: Remember each position. Visualize every move. Challenge yourself — and other players.
menu.previewCaption: EVERY MOVE STARTS IN THE MIND
menu.challengeSubhead: Two ways to train your memory
menu.hardcoreDescription: All pieces disappear after the first move. No looking back until the game is over.
menu.peeksDescription: Get 10 peeks. The board stays visible until you complete your next move.
menu.rankedDescription: Find an opponent at your level. Every game moves you up the Elo leaderboard.
menu.friendsDescription:
One room code. One familiar opponent.
See who remembers the board best.
menu.botDescription: No rating pressure. Choose a challenge and practice at your own pace.
menu.searching: Finding an opponent with a similar rating and game mode…
menu.searchRange: The Elo range gradually expands while you wait.
menu.footer: You don't need to see more. You need to remember better.
menu.rememberFirst: Remember the position. Visualize the move. Challenge yourself and real opponents.
